title: Same seed, two worlds, and a model that prefers the left-hand dutch
rundown:
Wednesday on Anlatan was a style fight with a quiet staff footnote. matts7123 posted a same-seed goblin barbarian walking from clean anime into photoreal and back again — no artist tags, just 1.4::anime:: against 0.6::photorealistic:: — and the thread treated it like a lab note instead of a flex. Meanwhile the room argued that V5 Full has a default-style attractor: artist tags sway less than they did on 4.5, Curated may be easier to pull, and luca confirmed the UI guidance default is 7 (not 3.5). guestavius could not get a clockwise dutch; weighting clockwise made it more counter-clockwise. The working joke-workaround is to put an object in the upper left so the frame has to tip the other way. Inpaint had the day's useful discovery: tagless English in the hole ("There is a huge marshmallow instead of a pillow") is beating tag fights, and a V5 crop sent into 4.5 inpaint wants Focused Area Selection with Minimum Context Area 32. luna (backend) answered the Opus meter in-channel: img2img drain follows Strength, not Noise; inpaint meters on V5 Full; Curated inpaint is still V4.5C; upscale is Anlas, not the battery. Webapp build 70a31dc-production. Contracts unchanged vs the Aug 28 dump. Not updated.

The unofficial server was smaller and meaner. pleasebankai cranked CFG 8 and prompt-guidance rescale to 0.8–1.0 for what they called a crack look. Amber reported plastic limbs below 15 steps. Aryllias described a V4.5 ladder: PR keepers, vibe img2img, PR again for corrections — typed chunks, not a UI preset. kinky and very-kinky were silent. nsfw-generation dumped images with no pasted prompts. No new verified V5 hip, weight-gain, or pregnancy recipes. Those spicy keepers stay off this public billboard.
official: Afternoon after 10:00 ET: 426 official messages, 30 technique. Morning since 8/28: 9,211 pulled / ~949 on-topic (heuristic). V5 needs much less emphasis than V4.5 (rarely >1.5; 5+ still for undertrained tags; same-seed test). Scout 14–18 steps; some stacks lose quality above ~20–23; complex multi-char 23–28. Character-box split anecdote: base = count + style + camera; actions in boxes (action can still bleed). Same-seed set: seed 336020714, 23 steps, 1216×832, scale 7, cfg_rescale 0, karras, k_euler_ancestral.
unofficial: Afternoon: 42 unofficial messages, 12 technique (all nai-image-gen-discussion). Morning since 8/28: 1,082 pulled / ~107 on-topic. CFG 8 + rescale 0.8–1.0. Sub-15 steps artifact. PR then vibe img2img then PR. No new hip/WG/pregnancy recipes.

sections.body: matts7123 walked a goblin barbarian from clean anime into photoreal and back again on Anlatan#nai-image-advice, copying the seed from the first gen so the pose would hold still. The set is a ladder, not a flex: bare anime, bare photorealistic, the two unweighted, then 1.2/0.8, 1.4/0.6, 1.6/0.4, 1.8/0.2. They leaned 1.4::anime::, 0.6::photorealistic::. The room treated it like a lab note. V5 Full still has a default-style attractor — artist tags sway less than they did on 4.5 — so a same-seed style pole is the honest way to see what the words actually do. Public stills: anime pole, photoreal pole, and the 1.4/0.6 lean. Unofficial spicy stay off this board.

sections.body: guestavius could not get a clockwise dutch on V5 without img2img. The tag dutch angle comes out counter-clockwise. Adding clockwise dutch angle, image is rotated clockwise did not flip it. Putting 3::clockwise:: in the same prompt made it even more counter-clockwise — inversion, not emphasis. The working joke-workaround is compositional, not a rotation tag: put an object in the upper left so the frame is not allowed to show it in the bottom left, and the camera has to tip the other way. luca, same afternoon, confirmed the UI guidance default is 7, not 3.5. Do not treat a leftover 4.5 3.5 as the V5 floor.

sections.body: awkj asked whether img2img V5 Opus drain scales with the Strength slider (a 0.01 strength duplicate: does the battery take a sip or a gulp?). luna (lun4, backend): lower Strength, yes. Noise, no — Noise is not linked to any scaling. Inpaint meters when you are on V5 Full; V5 Curated has no inpaint model and uses V4.5C inpainting. Upscale is a separate model, paid in Anlas, not the battery. Webapp 70a31dc-production. Contracts unchanged vs the Aug 28 dump.

sections.body: awkjfbikuaefb's afternoon note is the one that should travel: tagless plain text combined with inpainting is way better in V5 than exact-tag wars, as long as the tags do not fight the sentence. The example they typed is the whole recipe. A V5 crop that still needs 4.5's inpaint model should use Focused Area Selection so 4.5 can match V5 detail; the UI still on the day sheet is Minimum Context Area 32 (that number is from the still, not a chat quote). Same thread, powermate and .mandas on boxes: scene + style + camera can live in the base prompt; what a character does wants the box — and then it still bleeds.

excerpts.speaker: awkjfbikuaefb
excerpts.text: Note: Tagless plain text instructing such as "There is a huge marshmallow instead of a pillow." /combined with/ inpainting is way way better in V5

excerpts.text: As long as your tags don't conflict with your instructions you can save some serious time forgoing exact tags

excerpts.speaker: awkjfbikuaefb

sections.body:
Numeric hip cranks are a trap. Contrast in the character box (wide hips, narrow waist, thick thighs) still does more than a 3:: / 4:: stack. On Rapi the crank jumped breasts and barely moved hips. Distinct from the HOUSE ebiblue 2.2–2.8 note.

dataset_config.nsfw 3 strips hospital gowns and hoodies. Keep 2 Skimpy if you want a clothed belly and stretch marks. generate_image honors nsfw; apply_studio_changes can leave Neutral 0.

A long overdue belly wants landscape, negative space, side view. Portrait rounds it. quintuplets is a sibling-count tag — drop it unless you actually want siblings.

Leave dynagen off (enabled false, integrated true) on those jobs. Labor tags that trained: wince not wincing; fetal movement; lactation through clothes; water breaking, amniotic fluid, puddle, wet clothes. Drop UC grabbing stomach if she is rubbing her own belly.
